newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil CST to invest $360 mln in new mill.
newsitem.headline: Brazil CST to invest $360 mln in new mill.

text.p: Brazilian steel slabs producer Companhia Siderurgica Tubarao (CST) said it plans to invest $360 million over the next three years to build a new hot strip mill with an output capacity of 2 million tonnes of steel.
The new mill, expected to start operating in early 2000, will allow CST to transform part of its steel slabs production into coils, a company spokesman said.
The coils produced by the new hot strip mill are expected to be sold mostly in the local market to supply growing industries such as car, electrical appliance and construction sectors, he added.
CST plans to finance its investment plan with its own cash, loans from foreign banks and credit lines offered by Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES), he said.
The spokesman said the $360 million investment in the new hot strip mill should be added to the the $800 million investment plan announced last year.

Under the $800 million investment plan, CST will increase steel slabs production to 4.5 million tonnes in 1998 from 3.3 million tonnes in 1996 by building a second blast furnace and replacing old-fashioned slabbing mills with continuous cast machines.
